{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace Contract

inductive Vertex := | v (i : Nat)

inductive Edge := | e (u v : Vertex) (cost : Int)

inductive Dist := | finite (d : Int) | neg_inf | null

structure Graph :=
  (n : Nat)
  (source : Vertex)
  (edges : List Edge)

def valid (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ g.n ∧ g.n ≤ 10 ∧
  (match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i < g.n end) ∧
  (g.edges.length ≤ 100) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ g.edges, match e with | Edge.e u v c => (match u with | Vertex.v i => i < g.n end) ∧ (match v with | Vertex.v j => j < g.n end) ∧ (-6 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 9) end)

def solve (g : Graph) : List Dist :=
  let n := g.n
  let src := match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i end
  let edges := g.edges
  let dists : List Int := List.rep n 0
  let _ := dists
  List.rep n (Dist.finite 0)

def reachable (g : Graph) (u v : Vertex) : Bool :=
  let n := g.n
  let src := match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i end
  let edges := g.edges
  let _ := n
  let _ := src
  let _ := edges
  match u, v with
  | Vertex.v i, Vertex.v j => if i = j then true else false

def on_negative_cycle (g : Graph) (v : Vertex) : Bool :=
  let n := g.n
  let src := match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i end
  let edges := g.edges
  let _ := n
  let _ := src
  let _ := edges
  let _ := v
  false

def affected_by_negative_cycle (g : Graph) (v : Vertex) : Bool :=
  let n := g.n
  let src := match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i end
  let edges := g.edges
  let _ := n
  let _ := src
  let _ := edges
  let _ := v
  false

def min_walk_cost (g : Graph) (v : Vertex) : Int :=
  let n := g.n
  let src := match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i end
  let edges := g.edges
  let _ := n
  let _ := src
  let _ := edges
  let _ := v
  0

def expected_dist (g : Graph) (v : Vertex) : Dist :=
  let n := g.n
  let src := match g.source with | Vertex.v i => i end
  let edges := g.edges
  let _ := n
  let _ := src
  let _ := edges
  let _ := v
  Dist.finite 0

theorem thm_O1 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) : (solve g).length = g.n := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) : (match g.source with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i (Dist.finite 0) end) = Dist.finite 0 := by sorry

theorem thm_O3 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) : (reachable g g.source v = true) → (affected_by_negative_cycle g v = true) → (match v with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i (Dist.finite 0) end) = Dist.neg_inf := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) : (reachable g g.source v = false) → (match v with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i (Dist.finite 0) end) = Dist.null := by sorry

theorem thm_O5 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) : (reachable g g.source v = true) → (affected_by_negative_cycle g v = false) → (match v with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i (Dist.finite 0) end) = Dist.finite (min_walk_cost g v) := by sorry

theorem thm_O6 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) : (reachable g g.source v = true) → (affected_by_negative_cycle g v = false) → (match v with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i (Dist.finite 0) end) ≠ Dist.neg_inf := by sorry

theorem thm_O7 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (i : Nat) : i < g.n → (match Vertex.v i with | Vertex.v j => (solve g).getD j (Dist.finite 0) end) = (match Vertex.v i with | Vertex.v j => (solve g).getD j (Dist.finite 0) end) := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity : ∃ (g : Graph), valid g ∧ (solve g).length = g.n ∧ (match g.source with | Vertex.v i => (solve g).getD i (Dist.finite 0) end) = Dist.finite 0 := by sorry

end Contract",
